reasoning_notes: Analyzed 56 candidates across 7 causal chains. Genuine risks identified: 13. Scoring criteria: (1) Events must form causal sequence on single chain (50 pts per event), (2) Multiple independent sources per event (30 pts for quality >= 2), (3) Cross-organizational spread across 4+ regions and 5+ sites (40 pts) or 3+ regions/sites (20 pts), (4) Severe penalty for contradictions (-50 pts), (5) Temporal spread across 50+ days (+10/+20 pts). Real risks meet: score >= 50, sequence of 2+ events on same chain, 3+ regions, 3+ sites, zero contradictions.
